offers.name: Hall of Echoes
offers.perk: Speak a member's name and they hear you, anywhere in the city.

offers.name: Forge I: Anvil & Bellows
offers.perk: Free repairs; mundane weapons, armor, and ammo at half cost.
offers.reason: a branch-merchant who owes Mordecai a favor

roster.name: Mordecai
roster.notes: Gruff, sarcastic, world-weary; care hidden under complaints. Skills are placeholders.
roster.look: a scruffy, grey-whiskered rat-folk with tired eyes and a stained vest

roster.name: Rowan Sorrel
roster.ancestry: Human Barbarian (Path of the World Tree)
roster.notes: "Root": upbeat, reckless, fiercely loyal guild kid raised in Yggdrasil; lean, wiry, scarred chest, goofy grin.

roster.name: Goblin Archivist (name TBD)
roster.notes: Elderly goblin scholar in lavender spectacles; the guild's founding archivist who writes everything down. "Citation, dear?"

roster.name: Marigold "Goldie" Thrushwhistle
roster.title: guild master of the Cellar Lanterns (Iron 1)
roster.label: lantern-bearer who never lets anyone fall behind
roster.look: a brass lantern hat and a satchel of overdue paperwork
roster.public: The tireless champion of small guilds; hands out mandated jobs in person, with snacks.
roster.want: better pay and safer jobs for Iron guilds
roster.secret: She has been quietly paying other Iron guilds' revival fees from her own pocket and is nearly broke. She and Mordecai have history, and she won't say what.

roster.name: Captain Odessa Varn
roster.title: captain of the Tin Gale Company (Bronze 1)
roster.label: ex-sky-pirate with a hook blade and a grin
roster.look: a weathered sky-captain's coat with one sleeve pinned back
roster.voice: loud, laughs at her own threats
roster.manner: generous with drinks, stingy with trust
roster.public: Brash champion of expansion into new worlds; pushes for more branch permits and fewer rules.
roster.want: open every branch the Council keeps sealed
roster.secret: Her company smuggles cargo through sealed paths in the Roots, and one of those cargoes may be carrying rot.

roster.name: Professor Quillon Ashgrave-Mott
roster.title: head archivist of the Lamplit Archive (Silver 2)
roster.label: spell-archivist who fights with footnotes
roster.look: spectacles stacked three deep and ink on every feather
roster.public: The Council's stickler for procedure; nothing advances a tier without his stamp.
roster.want: a complete record of every world the Tree has touched
roster.secret: His archive's records show the rot follows a pattern, and he has found a name tied to it in an old guild ledger: one of Mordecai's former aliases.

roster.name: Sister Verdance
roster.title: Root-warden of the Green Vein Wardens (Gold 1)
roster.label: Root-warden who speaks with the Tree's sap
roster.look: bark-textured skin and moss that blooms when she's pleased
roster.voice: slow and gentle, as if listening to something else
roster.manner: serene, then suddenly fierce about the Tree
roster.public: The Tree's caretaker on the Council, said to be closest to the First.
roster.want: stop the rot before another world's Tree dies
roster.secret: She hasn't heard from the First in over a year and is terrified of what that silence means.

roster.name: Aurelian Vey
roster.title: guild master of the Gilded Spiral (Platinum 1)
roster.label: living legend in battered gold armor
roster.look: ageless, with one hand always gloved
roster.voice: rarely speaks; when he does, the room goes quiet
roster.public: Legend of the Tree; he hasn't lost a Council vote in forty years.
roster.want: a worthy successor, though he'd never admit it
roster.secret: A planar wound under his glove is slowly killing him. He watches new guilds closely, looking for whoever might one day hold the line after him.

roster.name: Tabaxi Monk (name TBD)
roster.ancestry: Tabaxi Monk (Warrior of the Open Hand)
roster.notes: Disciplined, blunt temple disciple in an indigo robe; trains before dawn, slow to trust, never leaves an ally behind.

vendor: a rival guild selling off old fixtures
dealr: off-season rates in the carpenters' quarter
